title: Common Collections and Text
summary: The three collections every program uses: Vec for lists, String for UTF-8 text, and HashMap for lookups by key, plus a map of the other standard collections.
goals: Create, read, update and iterate over vectors, and know when indexing panics
Explain why Rust strings cannot be indexed by position, and work with bytes, chars and slices
Build and update hash maps, including the entry API, and understand ownership of keys and values
Pick the right standard collection (Vec, VecDeque, HashMap, BTreeMap, HashSet, BTreeSet) for a job
